items.title: The plot was 89 by 100 — not 100 by 100
items.summary: A title search showed the land was smaller than the seller claimed — before any money was sent.
items.outcome: Fraud caught before any money was sent
items.body:
The situation

A client abroad was about to buy a plot the seller described as 100 by 100 ft.

What we found

Our report showed the land was actually 89 by 100 — smaller than what the seller had said.

The outcome

The client walked away from the deal before sending any money.

“StedPic saved me from abafele from Kampala!” — Paulo K.

items.title: Confirming the seller was the rightful owner
items.summary: After bad experiences buying land before, a client needed proof the seller had the right to sell.
items.body:
The situation

A client with past bad experiences buying land in Uganda wanted certainty before paying.

What we found

We confirmed the person selling was the rightful owner, with the right to sell.

The outcome

The client paid for the land with far less doubt and stress.

“I paid for my land with less doubt and stress.” — Eric K.

items.title: An accidental encroachment, found and fixed
items.summary: Drone photos combined with a boundary survey showed an owner had accidentally encroached on a neighbour's plot.
items.outcome: Encroachment found and resolved before it became a legal dispute
items.body:
The situation

An owner had been misled by the previous owner about where the boundaries were.

What we found

Pictures integrated with the boundary survey results showed the owner had accidentally encroached on a neighbour's plot.

The outcome

The issue was resolved, and the owner is now subscribed to Property Watch.

“The pictures integrated with the boundary survey results gave me a clear perspective.” — Angela M.
